يتمنطقون (form IIq)
# يَتَمَنْطَقُونَ (yatamanṭaqūna) /ja.ta.man.tˤa.quː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَمَنْطَقَ (tamanṭaqa)
# يُتَمَنْطَقُونَ (yutamanṭaqūna) /ju.ta.man.tˤa.quː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَمَنْطَقَ (tamanṭaqa)
